message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/pcre2demo.c')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('match_data = pcre2_match_data_create_from_pattern(re, NULL);

rc = pcre2_match(
  re,                   /* the compiled pattern */
  subject,              /* the subject string */
  subject_length,       /* the length of the subject */
  0,                    /* start at offset 0 in the subject */
  0,                    /* default options */
  match_data,           /* block for storing the result */
  NULL);                /* use default match context */
','match_data = pcre2_match_data_create_from_pattern(re, NULL);

/* Force JIT so the vulnerable ovector copy path is exercised. */
pcre2_jit_compile(re, PCRE2_JIT_COMPLETE);

rc = pcre2_match(
  re,                   /* the compiled pattern */
  subject,              /* the subject string */
  subject_length,       /* the length of the subject */
  0,                    /* start at offset 0 in the subject */
  0,                    /* default options */
  match_data,           /* block for storing the result */
  NULL);                /* use default match context */
')
p.write_text(s)
PY
make -C . -j2 pcre2demo >/tmp/build.log 2>&1 || (cat /tmp/build.log; exit 1)
cat /tmp/build.log | tail -20
